validation_gates.name: Immutable Pre-Registration
validation_gates.threshold: Formula, inputs & selectivity cutoff committed before grading
validation_gates.luck_removed: Eliminates hindsight bias, feature snooping & moving goalposts

validation_gates.name: Minimum Sample Power
validation_gates.threshold: N >= 200 graded singles; N >= 350 graded parlays / prop combos
validation_gates.luck_removed: Prevents small-sample coin-flip streaks (2026 alone has only 136 games)

validation_gates.name: Chronological Walk-Forward OOS
validation_gates.threshold: Strict expanding-window train <= Week t-1, predict Week t only
validation_gates.luck_removed: Prevents future-leakage of full-season PF/PA or injury outcomes

validation_gates.name: Closing Line Value (CLV) Skill t-Test
validation_gates.luck_removed: Isolates repeatable pricing skill from single-game fumble/OT variance

validation_gates.name: Vig-Adjusted ROI Confidence Bound
validation_gates.threshold: Bootstrap 95% lower bound of ROI > 0.0% after -110 vig (4.55% hold)
validation_gates.luck_removed: Ensures edge survives bookmaker vigorish and tail variance

validation_gates.name: Proper Scoring Calibration
validation_gates.threshold: Out-of-sample Brier & Log-Loss strictly lower than devigged market
validation_gates.luck_removed: Penalizes overconfident probability estimates before Kelly sizing

validation_gates.name: Empirical Copula Correlation Gate
validation_gates.threshold: Within-game leg rho estimated on >=1,000 team-games; 95% CI excludes book implied rho
validation_gates.luck_removed: Blocks SGP & prop-combo correlation tax traps

validation_gates.name: Benjamini–Hochberg Multiple-Testing FDR
validation_gates.threshold: Adjusted q-value <= 0.05 across all M candidate strategies tested
validation_gates.luck_removed: Stops 1-in-20 false-positive 'lucky winner' among 12+ parallel strategies

validation_gates.name: Selectivity & Luck-Residual Screen
validation_gates.threshold: Bet only top <=20% model-disagreement slates; strip Pythagorean & INT luck
validation_gates.luck_removed: Forces selective high-conviction skill bets instead of recreational action

strategies.name: Pythagorean Luck-Fade vs Pass-YPA Skill Spread
strategies.mechanism: Back teams with negative luck residual (e.g., TB -2.17w, HOU -1.40w) & positive Pass YPA Diff (r=+0.724) against over-lucky opponents (e.g., DEN +2.17w, CLE +1.53w).
strategies.selectivity: Abs(Model v2 - Market) >= 2.2 pts & |Luck Diff| >= 2.0 wins
strategies.gate_blocker: G1, G3, G4, G5 (Missing Historical Odds)

strategies.name: Secondary Multi-String Coverage Collapse Team-Total Over
strategies.mechanism: Target opposing offense Team Total Over when >=2 starting CB/S/NB defenders are replaced by 2nd/3rd/4th string backups (e.g., SF & DAL Week 10 clusters).
strategies.selectivity: >=2 DB starters OUT/DNP on verified club chart + Opp Off Passer Rate >= 92.0
strategies.corr_anchor: C-10 Def Pass Rate vs PA/g (r=+0.815)

strategies.name: Blindside / Interior OL 2nd–3rd String Pass-Pro Fade
strategies.mechanism: Fade offenses missing LT1 or C1/LG1+LG2 to 2nd/3rd string backups (e.g., NE LG1+LG2 out/DNP, MIA C1 DNP, WAS C1 OUT) vs top-12 pass-defense rating clubs.
strategies.selectivity: >=1 OL starter OUT + backup >=2nd string + Opp Def Pass Rate <= 88.0
strategies.gate_blocker: G1, G3–G5 (Missing Historical Odds & Snap Logs)

strategies.name: 3rd-Down Sustainability vs Raw Total Regression
strategies.mechanism: Exploit divergence between sustainable scrimmage Yds/Play (r=+0.760) + 3rd-Down% (r=+0.707) and noisy red-zone / turnover scoring spikes.
strategies.selectivity: Abs(Fair Total - Market Total) >= 2.8 pts & neutral weather/dome
strategies.gate_blocker: G1, G3–G5 (Missing Historical Closing Totals & Weather)

strategies.name: Verified 2nd/3rd-String QB Drop-OffOrigination Filter
strategies.mechanism: Price verified QB1 -> QB2/QB3 cascades (BAL QB3 Joe Fagnano, SEA QB2 Drew Lock, MIA rookie Kyle McCord) via career dropback prior rather than team season PF/g.
strategies.selectivity: Official NFL.com QB1 OUT/IR + verified club depth-chart replacement
strategies.corr_anchor: C-05 Off Pass Rate vs PF/g (r=+0.750)
strategies.gate_blocker: G1, G3–G5 (Missing Historical Odds & QB EPA Prior)

strategies.name: Cross-Game Independent High-CLV 2-Leg Parlay
strategies.mechanism: Combine exactly two independent games (verified rho = 0.00 across distinct stadiums/clubs) ONLY when each single leg independently clears +2.5% no-vig EV.
strategies.selectivity: Both legs pass Silver Tier single gates; max 0.15x Kelly stake

strategies.name: Trailing-Script Favorite Spread + Opp QB Pass-Attempts SGP
strategies.mechanism: Pair skill-favorite spread with trailing opponent QB pass attempts over when book SGP pricing underestimates negative-game-script pass rate shift.
strategies.selectivity: Copula joint prob > SGP implied prob + 4.0% correlation-margin buffer
strategies.gate_blocker: G6 HARD BLOCK (Requires PBP within-game rho) + G1, G3–G5

strategies.name: DB Backup Cluster + Opposing Passing Over SGP
strategies.mechanism: Combine opposing QB passing efficiency/yards over with opposing team-total over against defenses starting 2nd/3rd-string corners (SF, DAL, NE).
strategies.selectivity: >=2 DB starters OUT/DNP + verified copula edge > +4.5%
strategies.gate_blocker: G6 HARD BLOCK (Requires PBP within-game rho) + G1, G3–G5

strategies.name: Alpha WR1 Absence -> 2nd/3rd-String WR Reception Combo
strategies.mechanism: When WR1 (e.g., LAR Puka Nacua) exits lineup, model target reallocation to verified 2nd/3rd-string WRs (Whittington / Atwell) before prop books re-center.
strategies.selectivity: WR1 >= 26% target share OUT/IR + verified club depth-chart WR2/WR3
strategies.gate_blocker: G6 + Missing Official Snap/Route Participation & Prop Odds

strategies.name: RB1+RB2 Attrition -> 3rd/4th-String Receiving/Attempt Share
strategies.mechanism: Target touch-volume (NOT YPC, since Rush YPC vs PF/g r=+0.017!) when RB1+RB2 are out/DNP (e.g., NE Corey Kiner / Lan Larison; GB Lloyd / Strong).
strategies.selectivity: RB1 & RB2 OUT/DNP + verified 3rd/4th string active on game-day 48
strategies.gate_blocker: G1, G6 + Missing Historical Prop Lines & Game-Day Inactives

strategies.name: QB Passing Yards + Primary Pass-Catcher Yards Stack Combo
strategies.mechanism: Price bivariate Gaussian/t-copula stack against SGP prop-combo multiplier ONLY where bookmaker applies flat correlation haircut below empirical team target concentration.
strategies.selectivity: Pass-catcher >= 28% air-yards share + verified rho CI lower bound > book rho
strategies.gate_blocker: G6 HARD BLOCK (Within-game rho unverified) + Prop Odds

strategies.name: OL Multi-Backup Mismatch -> QB Sacks Taken + Under Pass YPA Combo
strategies.mechanism: Pair opposing defense/QB-sack prop with QB under yards-per-attempt when >=2 OL starters are replaced by 2nd/3rd string backups.
strategies.selectivity: >=2 OL starters OUT/DNP + Opp pressure rate top quartile
strategies.gate_blocker: G6 + Missing Historical Prop Odds & Pressure Participation
